QUOTE: `library/error.c` is generated by `scripts/generate_errors.pl` from the `MBEDTLS_ERR_*` `#define`s in `include/mbedtls/*.h`... The generator fills `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`, which emits the `#include` lines and `#if defined(MBEDTLS_<MOD>_C)` guards per module, and writes `library/error.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template.
